caption: You need a Project and one signed-in agent tool
line: Before you start, you need a Project open in Zana and one signed-in agent tool. Claude is the recommended choice.

caption: New agent → Launch mode → Squad
line: Click New agent, and under Launch mode, choose Squad.

caption: Squad picker: Research Squad
line: Pick Research Squad. It has two Low-tier investigators, a good fit for comparing options.

caption: Squad planning → Infer plan from goal
line: Leave Squad planning on Infer plan from goal. You describe what you want, and the Orchestrator writes the plan.

caption: Describe the goal in plain words
line: Describe the goal in plain words: what to look at, and what the report should contain. Be specific, and name the files or areas that matter.

caption: Goal limit: 2,048 characters
line: Goals hold up to 2,048 characters. Over that, Launch is disabled, so attach a plan or source instead.

caption: Check the Project → Launch squad
line: Check the Project, add a Title if you like, then press Launch squad.

caption: Zana checks requirements first
line: Zana checks the Squad's requirements first. If something is missing, it says what, and no workers start.

caption: A run takes as long as the plan needs
line: A run takes as long as the plan needs.
